description:
Hushfeed v0.72.0 has 134 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

47.1.4 is still the only supported version, so patch that APK with your usual signing key.

It's a big one. Hushfeed settings got rebuilt. Every page is on the main settings page now, and search can flip a switch right in the results. Quick setups turns on a whole set at once. Holding For You at the top of the feed opens settings. Show commenter handle and region and Profile background are new patches. The release notes list every report this release changed something for.

Validation: 4319 runtime tests passed and 890 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 134 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. Builds of this release were patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 and run on a Galaxy S22 and a Galaxy S25.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
